name: Furong Huang
title: Associate Professor, Computer Science

research.text: She specializes in trustworthy machine learning, AI for sequential decision-making, and high-dimensional statistics, applying theory to practical computing challenges. Her research focuses on creating reliable, interpretable models and developing algorithms that optimize performance while adhering to ethical and safety standards.

matched_projects.one_liner: At Arborphy AI (advised by Prof. Tian Zheng, Columbia Statistics) I built and stress-tested a BioCLIP + EfficientNet fusion model for fine-grained plant species recognition, and found with a leakage-aware, multi-seed protocol that the fusion gains did not reliably beat a BioCLIP-only baseline.
I built a multi-agent system with blind cross-model verification and trust levels that gate each stage's autonomy on measured error rates.
